title: Hotel snack vending · original Blender model
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Glass-front snack machine, 0.98 x 0.86 x 1.85 m: six trays of spiral coils loaded three deep with printed chip bags, candy and granola bars, cookies and crackers; price strips, keypad, tap-to-pay reader, lit lit LCD display ("MAKE SELECTION"), delivery bin, branded header. Original CC0, built by script in Blender 4.0 (projects/roadside-inn/blender/props.py); printed labels drawn by projects/roadside-inn/blender/labels.mjs, every brand invented. Meters, Y up, origin at floor center, front faces +Z.

title: Hotel coffee station · original Blender model
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Self-serve coffee bar, 3.2 m: oak and white credenza, three thermal servers on brew stands, hot water tower, oak cup caddy, condiment organizer, creamer cups, stir sticks, napkins, cookies. Cookies, creamer bottles and the tea box are separate take_* nodes, for games to lift out as pick-up-able props. Original CC0, built by script in Blender 4.0 (projects/roadside-inn/blender/). Meters, Y up, origin at floor center, front faces +Z. The condiment organizer is built from 8 mm boards: a hollow packet tray with sugar standing in five bins, an open cubby box with napkins and wrapped stirrers, creamer bottles on top; creamer cups rest in their bowl without overlapping.
